nodes.norm_label: config rules: gitignored file never manual; missing config names itself
nodes.rationale: Missing worker/.dev.vars broke CI once and a dev machine once as an opaque DataError.

nodes.label: HMAC-signed round state
nodes.rationale: Keeps the Worker stateless while making forged 'already found' progress impossible.

nodes.label: Only numbers cross the wire
nodes.rationale: Never text, vectors, ranks or table slices reach the client.

nodes.label: Placement is display, not progress
nodes.rationale: Placement never enters signed state; a forged placement only fools the forger.

nodes.label: Function words never count
nodes.rationale: They sit close to every word and would take most placements.

nodes.label: Normalization must stay in step
nodes.rationale: Changing normalize/tokenize invalidates all stored tables.
